metric: Q-error (max of over- and under-estimate ratio) of KumoSQL's statistics-only estimator on all 2,603 STATS-CEB sub-plan queries, against exact sizes. Same sub-plans: Postgres 16 p99 3,482; published BayesCard p99 156, FLAT 771, DeepDB 1,027.
caveats: Design choices (full storage of frequent keys, 2,000 frequent keys per domain) were made while looking at STATS-CEB (tuned on test). 10,000-row samples. Source: End-to-End-CardEst-Benchmark at 670cb8d.
correctness: Exact sizes by variable elimination in DuckDB; all 146 query sizes match the published ones. 2,603 of 2,603 sub-plans estimated, 0 errors.
coverage_of: Failures only: 0 errors over the 2,603 sub-plan estimates; equivalence outcomes do not apply.
held_out: none (JOB families 17-33 are the held-out workload)
performance: Pure Python; about 12 ms per sub-plan estimate
